item.title: Forwarding Celery task events to Socket.IO in a FastAPI app
item.description: In a FastAPI app that hands long-running jobs, such as training a model, to Celery workers, clients usually want to know how their task is doing: when it starts, how far along it is, and when it succeeds or fails. One way to do this is to build a feedback system of one’s own, with a dedicated queue in RabbitMQ that workers publish to and the API consumes. Celery already has such a mechanism, though: task events, which workers send through the broker and which anyone connected to it can receive. This article shows how to emit custom progress events from a task and forward all task events to clients with Socket.IO.
